title: Format-Preserving Authenticated Encryption for Compressed Video
summary: The paper handles still images under lossy JPEG compression; designing format-preserving authenticated encryption for video undergoing compression remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether one can construct a format-preserving authenticated-encryption scheme for videos that undergo compression.

scope.domain: Design of format-preserving, compression-tolerating authenticated-encryption schemes for video.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a format-preserving authenticated-encryption scheme for videos that undergo compression.

citations.label: Format-Preserving Compression-Tolerating Authenticated Encryption for Images

progress.summary: The source treats still images under lossy JPEG compression and explicitly asks whether format-preserving authenticated encryption can be designed for videos undergoing compression.
citation_labels: Alexandra Boldyreva et al., Format-Preserving Compression-Tolerating Authenticated Encryption for Images
